name: Claude-Red
description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
one_liner: A free library of structured guides that teach an AI coding assistant expert-level offensive-security methodology — from SQL injection to exploit development — for use in authorized security testing.
buyer: A red-team lead or security training company that wants to speed up authorized penetration tests and CTF prep using an AI assistant pre-loaded with attack methodology.
business_use_cases: A boutique pentesting firm equips its AI-assisted engagements with these skills so junior testers get senior-level attack methodology on tap during authorized tests.
A cybersecurity training company builds CTF practice courses and workshops around these skills, since they already map attack categories to runnable methodology.
A bug bounty hunter uses the relevant skill files to speed up triage and payload crafting on in-scope, authorized targets.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid training course or workshop that teaches security teams how to use these skills effectively in authorized engagements.
Offer managed, AI-assisted pentesting services where this skill library is the methodology backbone, billed per engagement.

steal_this: The skills themselves are free and open, so the real business is the service wrapped around them: package a one-day 'AI-assisted pentest readiness' workshop for security teams.
